brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The ASBU executive council meeting was held in Tunisia with Oman participating. [1]
Tunisia's boat industry is booming, producing vessels from pleasure craft to luxury yachts. [2]
Migrants in Tunisia are being pressured to go home, facing conditions described as voluntary return or being pushed out against their will. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TUNISIA
The ASBU meeting in Tunisia indicates regional aviation cooperation involving the country. [3]
The growth in Tunisia's boat industry suggests expanding manufacturing and export capacity for marine vessels. [2]

KEY RISKS
Migrants in Tunisia face pressure to leave, with reports of being pushed out against their will. [4]

WATCH ITEMS
The treatment of migrants in Tunisia, including whether returns are voluntary or forced, remains unresolved. [5]
